name: haulcast
description: Shortcuts for the whole repo. Same idea as scripts in a frontend package.json: run them with `npm run <name>` from this folder.

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3.15 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
